intro_en: In this lesson you'll talk about spending beyond your means to impress relatives and neighbors, using words like нэр хүнд, хов жив and хүний нүд. You'll practice two ways of saying "pretend" in Mongolian (-сан дүр үзүүлэх and -х дүр эсгэх) and the English expressions "avail oneself of" and "content oneself with."
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр хамаатан садан, хөршдөө гайхуулах гэж чадлаасаа хэтэрсэн мөнгө үрэх тухай нэр хүнд, хов жив, хүний нүд зэрэг үгээр ярилцана. Мөн англи хэлний "avail oneself of", "content oneself with" хэллэгийг ашиглаж сурна.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр нэр хүндээ хамгаалах гэж өрөнд оржээ.
vocab.example_en: He went into debt to protect his reputation.

vocab.example_mn: Хорооллоор нэг хов жив тархаад байна.
vocab.example_en: Some gossip is going around the neighborhood.

vocab.example_mn: Хүний нүднээс ичээд л тэд хуримаа томоор хийсэн.
vocab.example_en: They threw a big wedding just because they cared what people would think.
She showed off her new shoes to her friends.
There's no need to buy gifts you can't afford.

vocab.example_mn: Олон гэр бүл Цагаан сараар өрөнд ордог.
vocab.example_en: Many families go into debt over Tsagaan Sar.
An extravagant lifestyle doesn't last long.
Learn to be content with little.

vocab.example_mn: Хадмууд маань ирэх сард манайд ирнэ.
vocab.example_en: My in-laws are coming to visit us next month.

sentences.mn: Тэд хүний нүднээс ичээд хуримаа зээлээр хийсэн.
sentences.en: They paid for their wedding with a loan because they cared what people would think.
alt_mn: Хүний нүднээс ичсэндээ тэд хуримаа зээлээр хийсэн.
alt_en: Worried about what people would say, they took out a loan for their wedding.
sentences.mn_latin: Ted khünii nüdnees icheed khurimaa zeeleer khiisen.

sentences.mn: Цагаан сараар хамаатнууддаа гайхуулах гэж тэр шинэ машин зээлээр авчээ.
sentences.en: He bought a new car on credit to show off to his relatives at Tsagaan Sar.
alt_en: To impress his relatives during Tsagaan Sar, he bought a new car on credit.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsagaan saraar khamaatnuuddaa gaikhuulakh gej ter shine mashin zeeleer avchee.

sentences.mn: Хов живэнд өртөхгүйн тулд бид чадлаасаа хэтэрсэн том найр хийлээ.
sentences.en: To avoid becoming the subject of gossip, we threw a party far beyond our means.
alt_en: So that people wouldn't gossip about us, we threw a party we couldn't afford.
sentences.mn_latin: Khov jivend örtökhgüin tuld bid chadlaasaa khetersen tom nair khiilee.

sentences.mn: Тэр хөршүүддээ Дубайд амарсан дүр үзүүлсэн ч зургууд нь интернэтээс авсан байв.
sentences.en: He acted as if he had vacationed in Dubai in front of his neighbors, but his photos were from the internet.
alt_en: He pretended to his neighbors that he'd been on vacation in Dubai, but the photos came from the internet.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter khörshüüddee Dubaid amarsan dür üzüülsen ch zurguud ni intyernetees avsan baiv.

sentences.mn: Тооцоо ирэхэд найз маань төлөх дүр эсгэн түрийвчээ ухаж эхлэв.
sentences.en: When the bill came, my friend made as if to pay and started digging through his wallet.
alt_mn: Тооцоо ирэхэд найз маань төлөх гэж байгаа дүр эсгэн түрийвчээ ухав.
alt_en: When the check came, my friend pretended he was about to pay and rummaged through his wallet.
sentences.mn_latin: Tootsoo irekhed naiz maani tölökh dür esgen türiivchee ukhaj ekhlev.

sentences.mn: Бид хоёр өрөө байрандаа сэтгэл ханаж, том байшингийн мөрөөдлөө орхисон.
sentences.en: We contented ourselves with our two-room apartment and gave up our dream of a big house.
alt_en: We were content with our two-room apartment and let go of the dream of a big house.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid khoyor öröö bairandaa setgel khanaj, tom baishingiin möröödlöö orkhison.

sentences.mn: Тэр банкны хөнгөлөлттэй зээлийг ашиглаж, ээждээ шинэ гэр авч өгчээ.
sentences.en: She availed herself of the bank's low-interest loan and bought her mother a new ger.
alt_en: She took advantage of the bank's low-interest loan to buy her mother a new ger.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter bankny khöngölölttei zeeliig ashiglaj, eejdee shine ger avch ögchee.

sentences.mn: Нэр хүндээ хадгалах гэж өрөнд орох нь утгагүй.
sentences.en: It's pointless to go into debt just to protect your reputation.
alt_mn: Нэр хүндээ хамгаалах гэж өрөнд орох нь утгагүй хэрэг.
alt_en: There's no point going into debt just to save your reputation.
sentences.mn_latin: Ner khündee khadgalakh gej örönd orokh ni utgagüi.

sentences.mn: Хадмууд маань ирэхэд бид зээлээр тавилга авч, сайхан амьдарч байгаа дүр эсгэсэн.
sentences.en: When my in-laws visited, we bought furniture on credit and pretended we were living well.
alt_en: When my in-laws came over, we bought furniture on credit and acted like we were doing great.
sentences.mn_latin: Khadmuud maani irekhed bid zeeleer tavilga avch, saikhan amidarch baigaa dür esgesen.

sentences.mn: Хүмүүс юу гэж хэлэх бол гэж санаа зовсоор бид өөрсдийнхөө амьдралаар амьдрахаа мартжээ.
sentences.en: We worried so much about what people would say that we forgot to live our own lives.
alt_en: Always worrying about what others might say, we forgot to live for ourselves.
sentences.mn_latin: Khümüüs yuu gej khelekh bol gej sanaa zovsoor bid öörsdiinkhöö amidralaar amidrakhaa martjee.

sentences.mn: Хөдөөнөөс ирсэн хамаатнууддаа гайхуулах гэж тэр хамгийн үнэтэй хоолыг захиалав.
sentences.en: He ordered the most expensive dish to show off to his relatives from the countryside.
alt_en: To impress his relatives visiting from the countryside, he ordered the priciest dish.
sentences.mn_latin: Khödöönöös irsen khamaatnuuddaa gaikhuulakh gej ter khamgiin ünetei khoolyg zakhialav.

sentences.mn: Мөнгө хүрэлцээгүй тул бид даруухан найрт сэтгэл ханахаас өөр аргагүй байлаа.
sentences.en: Since we didn't have enough money, we had to content ourselves with a modest celebration.
alt_en: We didn't have enough money, so we had no choice but to settle for a modest party.
sentences.mn_latin: Möngö khüreltseegüi tul bid daruukhan nairt setgel khanakhaas öör argagüi bailaa.

grammar.title_en: Two ways to pretend: -сан дүр үзүүлэх and -х дүр эсгэх
grammar.title_mn: Avail oneself of / content oneself with
grammar.explain_en: Both patterns mean "to pretend," but the verb form before дүр changes the meaning. A past participle (-сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн) plus дүр үзүүлэх or дүр эсгэх means "to act as if something has happened or is already true": амарсан дүр үзүүлэх means "to act as if you've been on vacation," and сонсоогүй дүр эсгэх means "to pretend you didn't hear." A future participle (-х) plus дүр эсгэх means "to make as if to do something," usually a gesture you never complete: төлөх дүр эсгэх means "to make as if to pay." For an ongoing state, use -ж байгаа: сайхан амьдарч байгаа дүр эсгэх means "to pretend to be living well." Дүр үзүүлэх emphasizes the show you put on for others. Дүр эсгэх is more neutral.
grammar.explain_mn: "Avail oneself of + нэр үг" нь "боломж, үйлчилгээг ашиглах" гэсэн албан хэллэг юм. Энд өөрийгөө заасан төлөөний үг (myself, herself, ourselves) заавал орох ба угтвар үг нь үргэлж "of" байна. Жишээ: She availed herself of the loan. "Content oneself with + нэр үг" нь "илүүг хүсэлгүй, байгаа юмандаа сэтгэл ханах, тэр хэмжээндээ болих" гэсэн утгатай. Угтвар үг нь үргэлж "with" байна. Жишээ: We contented ourselves with a small party. Энэ хэллэг ихэвчлэн "илүү ихийг хүсэж байсан ч" гэсэн өнгө аястай. Ярианы хэлэнд "take advantage of", "settle for" гэж хэлж болно.

examples.mn: Тэр Солонгост сайн ажил хийдэг байсан дүр үзүүлдэг.
examples.en: He acts as if he had a good job in Korea.
examples.mn_latin: Ter Solongost sain ajil khiideg baisan dür üzüüldeg.

examples.mn: Охин унтсан дүр эсгэж, ээжийнхээ яриаг чагнав.
examples.en: The girl pretended to be asleep and listened in on her mother's conversation.
examples.mn_latin: Okhin untsan dür esgej, eejiinkhee yariag chagnav.

examples.mn: Тэр явах дүр эсгэн хаалга руу алхав.
examples.en: She made as if to leave and walked toward the door.
examples.mn_latin: Ter yavakh dür esgen khaalga ruu alkhav.

examples.mn: Бид үнэгүй зөвлөгөөг ашиглаж, бага цалиндаа сэтгэл ханаж сурсан.
examples.en: We availed ourselves of the free advice and learned to content ourselves with a small salary.
examples.mn_latin: Bid ünegüi zövlögöög ashiglaj, baga tsalindaa setgel khanaj sursan.

fill_blank.text: Тэр төлбөр төл___ дүр эсгэн түрийвчээ гаргав.
fill_blank.translation: He made as if to pay and took out his wallet.
fill_blank.explain_en: The future participle -х before дүр эсгэх means "to make as if to do" an action that never actually happens. The vowel ө follows vowel harmony with төл-.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "-х дүр эсгэх" нь хийх гэж байгаа мэт харагдуулахыг илэрхийлнэ. "Төл-" үйл үгийн эгшиг зохицлоор "-өх" болно.

fill_blank.translation: Spreading gossip is a bad habit.
fill_blank.explain_en: Хов жив (gossip) is a fixed pair word, and the two halves always go together.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Хов жив" нь хос үг тул салгаж болохгүй.

fill_blank.text: Нэр хүнд___ хадгалах гэж тэд өрөнд оров.
fill_blank.translation: They went into debt to protect their reputation.
fill_blank.explain_en: The reflexive possessive accusative -ээ means "their own reputation" as a direct object. After хүнд (vowel ү), the ending takes the vowel э.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Шууд тусагдахуун тул ерөнхий хамаатуулах заахын тийн ялгалын "-ээ" нөхцөл орно.

fill_blank.text: She availed herself ___ the free legal advice.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Avail oneself" хэллэгийн дараа үргэлж "of" угтвар үг орно.

fill_blank.text: We contented ourselves ___ a quiet dinner at home.
fill_blank.translation: Бид гэртээ нам гүмхэн оройн хоол идэхэд сэтгэл ханасан.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Content oneself" хэллэг үргэлж "with" угтвар үгтэй хэрэглэгдэнэ.

fill_blank.text: He ___ himself of every opportunity to meet important people.
fill_blank.translation: Тэр нөлөө бүхий хүмүүстэй танилцах боломж бүрийг ашигласан.
fill_blank.explain_en: Only "avail" fits the pattern "___ himself of." "Used" and "benefited" don't take a reflexive pronoun plus "of."
fill_blank.explain_mn: "___ himself of" бүтцэд зөвхөн "availed" тохирно. "Used", "benefited" үгс "himself of"-той хэрэглэгддэггүй.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Үеэл маань хуримаа хийх гэж арван сая төгрөгийн зээл авсан гэнэ.
dialogue.en: I heard my cousin took out a ten-million-tugrik loan for her wedding.
dialogue.mn_latin: Üyeel maani khurimaa khiikh gej arvan saya tögrögiin zeel avsan gene.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Арван сая? Яагаад ийм чадлаасаа хэтэрсэн юм хийдэг юм бэ?
dialogue.en: Ten million? Why would anyone go so far beyond their means?
dialogue.mn_latin: Arvan saya? Yaagaad iim chadlaasaa khetersen yum khiideg yum be?

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Хүний нүднээс ичээд л тэр. Хадмууд нь их нэр хүндтэй айл юм.
dialogue.en: She's just worried about what people will think. Her in-laws are a very respected family.
dialogue.mn_latin: Khünii nüdnees icheed l ter. Khadmuud ni ikh ner khündtei ail yum.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Даруухан хурим хийвэл хов жив гарна гэж айж байгаа юм байлгүй.
dialogue.en: She's probably afraid people will gossip if the wedding is modest.
dialogue.mn_latin: Daruukhan khurim khiivel khov jiv garna gej aij baigaa yum bailgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Тийм. Тэгээд одоо зээлээ төлж чадахгүй ч бүх юм сайхан байгаа дүр эсгэж яваа.
dialogue.en: Exactly. And now she can't pay the loan back, but she's pretending everything is fine.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim. Tegeed odoo zeelee tölj chadakhgüi ch bükh yum saikhan baigaa dür esgej yavaa.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Бид хоёр л жижигхэн хуримдаа сэтгэл ханасан нь зөв байж.
dialogue.en: Looks like we were right to content ourselves with a small wedding.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bid khoyor l jijigkhen khurimdaa setgel khanasan ni zöv baij.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ. Өрөнд орж гайхуулснаас амар тайван амьдрах нь дээр.
dialogue.en: Absolutely. Living in peace is better than going into debt to show off.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee. Örönd orj gaikhuulsnaas amar taivan amidrakh ni deer.

culture_note.en: In Mongolia, weddings, Tsagaan Sar gifts and children's graduation parties are often seen as a public measure of a family's standing. The phrase "хүний нүд" (people's eyes) captures the pressure to look prosperous. Consumer loans and salary-backed credit are easy to get, so many families borrow to keep up, and stories of a lavish wedding followed by years of debt are a common topic of social commentary.
culture_note.mn: Монголд хурим, Цагаан сарын бэлэг, хүүхдийн төгсөлтийн баяр зэргийг гэр бүлийн байр суурийг харуулах үзүүлэлт мэт хардаг. "Хүний нүд" гэдэг үг чинээлэг харагдах гэсэн нийгмийн дарамтыг сайн илэрхийлдэг. Хэрэглээний болон цалингийн зээл авахад хялбар тул олон айл гадаад төрхөө хадгалах гэж зээл авдаг бөгөөд тансаг хурим хийгээд олон жил өр төлөх явдал нийгэмд байнга яригддаг сэдэв болжээ.

review.notes: A strong, natural lesson. The only real error is the vowel-harmony mistake in one fill-in-the-blank item, plus a wrong grammar term in its Mongolian explanation.

opus_fix.notes: Lesson is in good shape. Only one colloquial contraction in the dialogue needed fixing; everything else is accurate and consistent.

changes.why: "айгаа" is a spoken contraction; the standard written form is "айж байгаа"
